Messaging apps must stay linked to an active SIM from 2027

By A. Reporter · 23 October 2026 · 4 min read

Telecom rules published this week say messaging apps used in India will have to confirm that the SIM used to register an account is still present and active in the device. This page is a test fixture for Frameflow's capture step, not a real article.

Officials said the change targets account takeovers and fraud. Industry groups asked for more time.
